params.body:
The handover list ranked clients and suppliers on one calendar year, the last full one (2025). A client with a large project in 2024 and nothing invoiced in 2025 dropped off the list, and every reason line said "in 2025".

## Change

- `Network::shares()` gives each row a `recent` share: its part of the invoices of the last 36 months up to today.
- `Agenda` ranks the top 30 clients and suppliers on that share, and the high-importance tiebreak uses it too.
- The reason line reads "7,5% van de omzet, de laatste drie jaar" (and "van de aankopen" for suppliers), in line with "de laatste drie maanden" for projects and people.
- The yearly shares stay as they were for the export and the yearly view.

## Tests

- New: a client invoiced two years ago and not since still ranks first; one invoiced four years ago does not appear.
- 355 PHP tests, pint and 22 JS tests pass.
